Daily Devotional

February 13

31 Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God. (1 Corinthians 10:31 KJV)

Paul is talking about our actions, and if we would follow the commands of this verse, we would be Christ like. We should do everything, whether eating, drinking, working, playing, or anything else, we should do it to the glory of God. If we would let Christ live through us, and die to ourselves (Romans 14:8), then we would act this way. So few of us ever get to the point of living our lives the way Christ would, and acting the way He did while He was on the earth. Most of us don’t have much fruit in our lives, to show that we are the temple of the Lord (1 Corinthians 3:16). The fruit of our salvation should be love and obedience to Jesus (Hebrews 5:9).

The name Christian, literally means Little Christ, and was a term given the members of the early church, as the religious people said they were acting just like Jesus. Wow, I wish people would say that about me. Back then they meant it as a put down, but we should consider it a compliment. Do you live your life, so that people know you are a Christian? Most of us don’t come close to being like Jesus, even though He lives inside us, if we are born again (Galatians 4:6). We need to die to our old carnal selves, and begin to let Jesus live through us, so that we will live up to the name of being a Christian. You do that by giving yourself to God as a living sacrifice (Romans 12:1), which is the least we can do for our Lord. Thank you Jesus for all our blessings.
